claim: Construct the actual complex surface atlas on the original compact quaternion-order period quotient and prove holomorphy of its original projection and order action.

obligations.name: Objects
obligations.constructed_input: The original period quotient, its quotient topology, discrete original-order subgroup and actual complex-vector carrier C² are unchanged. New local charts are the precise localInverseAt charts of that quotient projection; no unrelated topology or freely supplied chart family is introduced.

obligations.name: Indices
obligations.constructed_input: Every quotient point is covered by a chosen actual lift, and every pair of actual local charts is included in the transition proof. Every element of the original integral order is covered by the descended-linear holomorphy theorem.

obligations.name: Domain
obligations.constructed_input: The generic atlas applies to every discrete additive subgroup of C². The original-surface specialization supplies this discreteness from the exact original-order lattice calculation and retains Im(τ)>0, including proof-only positivity arguments in compactness and Hausdorffness. It does not assert that arbitrary period parameters produce the same polarized structure.

obligations.constructed_input: Chart transitions are actual translations z↦z+d with quotient(d)=0, not approximate or sign-forgetting changes. obligations.constructed_input: A target-chart inverse identity at the specified point provides d; openness of that actual chart target and continuity of translation give an actual neighborhood where the inverse agrees with translation. AnalyticAt.congr is applied in its verified direction using the symmetry of the established inverse=translation germ. No inverse holomorphy premise is assumed.
